correction_statement: The 80% definition was corrected after the first definition (true crossing = first scored cycle with y <= 80 + 1e-9) returned zero crossings in 0 of 40 batch-3 cells, and before any 80% result was seen. 07b also used the registry column cycle_life_field, which for the five stitched development cells is only the batch-1 record length + 1; cycle_life_final is the correct column.

eol_80.counts_only_if: the alert fires at a scored cycle <= cycle_life_final
eol_80.delay_summaries: mean and median absolute delay (cycles and % of life) are over cells that fired
eol_80.early_alarm: fires more than 5% of life before cycle_life_final; early_pct = early alarms / all cells
eol_80.lead_time: cycle_life_final - fire cycle, median over cells that fired (reported for rule B)
eol_80.missed: no alert at a scored cycle <= cycle_life_final; missed_pct = missed cells / all cells
eol_80.rule_B: conformal lower bound <= 80.0, lower = estimate - ql[bin(estimate)], pooled ql (primary); cell-balanced ql as sensitivity
eol_80.truth: 80% EOL = cycle_life_final; no y <= 80 crossing is used

monitor_config.status: unchanged; EMA alpha and conformal tables are read from it and never recomputed

name: Phase 7b2 monitor configuration addendum
series: raw and EMA series both reported; EMA alpha and conformal tables per window and series come from monitor_config.json
test_set_status: Batch 3 is spent: labels are used for descriptive reporting only and nothing is chosen with them.

warning_85.early_alarm: fires more than 5% of life before the crossing
warning_85.missed: never fires by end of life (right-censored)
warning_85.note: computed with the 7b functions and cycle_life_final; the result must equal 7b
warning_85.rule_A: fires at the first scored cycle with estimate <= 85.0
warning_85.signal: raw M0 ensemble-mean estimate (D84); the EMA series is reported alongside
warning_85.truth: 85% crossing = first scored cycle with y <= 85.0 + 1e-9
